tickets.title: Request estate document package
tickets.text:
Subject: Estate planning document request

Hello Nolan Wrenpuddle,

To help keep the financial plan and account records aligned with the current estate plan, please send copies of any available documents listed below:

- Will
- Revocable trust or other trust agreements
- Trust amendments or restatements
- Durable power of attorney
- Health care directive or medical power of attorney
- Beneficiary designation confirmations
- Letters of instruction or executor/trustee contact details
- Any recent attorney summary letter

If another professional should provide these directly, please share the professional’s name, firm, email, and phone number: Celia Thimblefern (attorney); firm, email, and phone not confirmed.

Preferred secure delivery method: [secure portal / encrypted email / mail / other: ________]
Documents already on file: 2014 revocable trust and will
Documents still needed: Later restatement, trustee acceptance language, durable power of attorney, health care directive, attorney summary letter

Thank you,
Mira Quillwhistle

This request is to obtain the current estate document package for Nolan Wrenpuddle by 2026-02-19, including any updates prepared by attorney Celia Thimblefern after the death of his spouse Carla Wrenpuddle. The file currently holds only the 2014 trust and will, and missing documents are needed to confirm trustee authority and beneficiary designations.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the current estate document package by 2026-02-19.

tickets.title: Resolve Roth IRA beneficiary inconsistency
tickets.text: Review the Roth IRA beneficiary designation for Nolan Wrenpuddle, which currently names the 2014 revocable trust as sole beneficiary, while the traditional IRA designates Lena Wrenpuddle and Oscar Wrenpuddle equally. Confirm whether the trust should remain on the Roth IRA or be updated to match the children as direct beneficiaries per Nolan's expectation for administrative simplicity.
tickets.evidence: Further follow-up is needed by 2026-02-26 on the IRA beneficiary inconsistency, because Nolan expected both retirement accounts to pass directly to his children unless there was a specific reason to keep the trust on one account.

tickets.title: Administer trust account setup and maintenance
tickets.text:
Coordinate trust account administration from authority verification through ongoing recordkeeping. Confirm trustee powers, account registration requirements, cash needs, investment constraints, tax reporting responsibilities, and documentation standards before assets are moved or invested.

This follow-up focuses on verifying the successor trustee sequence and authority evidence for Nolan Wrenpuddle's revocable trust, where the deceased spouse Carla Wrenpuddle remains listed as first successor trustee ahead of sister Priya Nettlewhisk, and it is unclear whether Priya signed any trustee acceptance or whether a child should be added. This review is needed by 2026-03-05 to inform future trust account administration steps.

subTasks.title: Verify trustee authority and trust instructions
subTasks.text: Collect the signed trust agreement, relevant amendments, trustee acceptance or certification, and any custodian-specific trustee forms for Nolan Wrenpuddle's revocable trust. Identify distribution standards, successor trustee provisions (Carla Wrenpuddle deceased, Priya Nettlewhisk next), tax identification needs, and any limits on investment discretion.

subTasks.title: Prepare account opening and asset transfer package
subTasks.text: Assemble trust account application materials, transfer forms, cost basis records if available, and a checklist of assets expected to move into the trust account. Confirm titling language before submission.

subTasks.title: Establish administration calendar and records folder
subTasks.text: Create a reusable recordkeeping structure for statements, receipts, disbursements, tax documents, beneficiary notices, and trustee decisions. Add periodic reminders for cash review, tax reporting, and required beneficiary communications.
